def poly64(t):

    p = -0.0011264356
    p = p*sq + 0.0059712074
    p = p*sq - 0.015329496

    p = p*sq - 0.043983627

approx = poly64(m.to(torch.float64)[(m>0)&(m<=1.0)].to(torch.float64)) if False else None

sys.path.insert(0, "/root/cases/case_99")
import kernel as K

vals = torch.arange(65536, dtype=torch.int32).to(torch.int16).view(torch.float16)
vals = vals[torch.isfinite(vals)]
m = vals.abs()
# values in the polynomial branch region, focused near the boundary 1.0
sub = vals[(m > 0.5) & (m <= 1.0)]
sub = sub.cuda()
out = K.run(sub)
ref = torch.asinh(sub.to(torch.float64))
err = (out.to(torch.float64) - ref).abs()
i = err.argmax()
print(json.dumps({
